## 1.0.0 - public launch

RUN is now officially released on CurseForge and Wago Addons. This is the stable
build from the 0.9.x beta, promoted to 1.0 - no gameplay changes from the last
beta, just the version that marks the public launch.

Carried in from the final beta: the "RUN has been blocked" message on reload is
gone (the odds panel no longer anchors to Blizzard's target frame), and minimap
pins now ride on HereBeDragons-Pins, the same engine other map addons use, so
they place consistently with everything else.

What RUN does: enemies grow with every player they fell - notoriety tiers, earned
titles, banners, and honest odds against the creatures around you. Pairs with
Foresight for deeper character-aware odds.

Works on WoW: Forever (1.60.x) and Classic Era (1.15.x). Display-and-advice only,
official APIs only, never networks - you auto-update through your addon manager.
